Published formalize checkpoint 5be668e2e5d790db8e88829b211e7376ed7a987e; proof db94389dc115be902e14e9c8f1bdf5b87af0e1f3. Actual checked prefixes from an unbound node request now derive the SAME optional instruction's captured compiler owner, actual lookup/demand cells, entered domain and exact child return. Strong induction uses enclosing query fuel; nested compiler cuts can have equal child/compiler fuel. SourceCurrentNativeOwnedGeneration.execute retains that owner with the SAME stopping-generation tuple, done/pending operation, encoded source build and rooted writer, or the exact initial full cell. No owner or future completion premise is supplied.

Nine modules, twelve public declaration full readbacks (including the Owner definition), one actual source-built compiled-root example, ten empty selected strict logs. Default audit passes 3504 jobs and 74153 axiom checks; only the earlier ClosedCompletion warning remains. Scope retains 62 capped Lean/Lake commands, 17 failed commands (16 elaboration, one missing-source build before Lean), and all warning attempts. The fixture reaches the compiler's own optional site after four actual checked steps; it stops before optional execution and does not demonstrate new Mu installation. Every tracked blob/mode and all 720 evidence checksums passed local clean closure before push. Remote formalize matches; main remains 9769fe3e9.

Important boundaries: suspended capture is in chosen after lookup; evaluating capture is in running after demand. Neither query/capture equality nor owner retention at the optional/final state is proved. Next: original-program binding ancestry, then global renewal/active-owner exclusion and outer completion. Concrete Haskell refinement remains open. All 268 Haskell files and 207 active package files retain their bytes; root FINDINGS keeps external Haskell follow-ups first. Read lean/notes-current-native-optional-owner.md and lean/restart-evidence/20261020-native-optional-owner-prefix/next-owner-ancestry-handoff.md. Full-library goal stays active.
